title: Finite-free restriction preserves the system geometric adjunction calculus
statement:
Fix $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ of characteristic $p$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, and finite extensions $E\subset L$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, with valuation rings $R\subset S$, uniformizers $\pi,v$, and ramification index $e$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber, def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. For $n\ge1$ put $A_n=R/\pi^n$ and $B_n=S/\pi^nS=S/v^{en}$, with the actual quotient transitions. Fix one $R$-basis of $S$ and use its reductions at every level [lem-sfb-local-field-integral-basis]. On fixed small pro-etale sites of separated finite-type $k$-schemes $W$, let $\mathscr S_{A,W}$ and $\mathscr S_{B,W}$ be the abelian categories of strict semilinear module systems: objects are module sheaves $M_n$ with linear maps $M_{n+1}\to\operatorname{Res}M_n$, and morphisms are componentwise maps commuting with these transitions [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-size-convention, def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties, lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections]. Use their ordinary unbounded derived categories. Let $U_W$ be termwise restriction from $B_\bullet$ to $A_\bullet$ and $T_W=-\otimes^L_{A_\bullet}B_\bullet$ derived scalar extension [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars, lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings].

The constant coefficient system $B_{\bullet,W}$ is normalized as an $A_\bullet$-system: the canonical maps $B_m\otimes^L_{A_m}A_n\to B_n$ are isomorphisms for every $m\ge n$. Its levels are constructible and have Tor amplitude $[0,0]$, and every scheme pullback takes it to the corresponding constant system [def-coef-normalized-dvr-tower, def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility, def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude].

On abelian system categories, ordinary extension $-\otimes_{A_\bullet}B_\bullet$ and restriction are exact and adjoint, and restriction carries K-injective complexes to K-injective complexes [def-pur-kinjective-complex]. Their termwise localizations compute $T_W,U_W$. There is a derived adjunction $T_W\dashv U_W$ whose bijection sends $a:T_WP\to Q$ to $U_W(a)\eta_P$, with unit $\eta_P$ induced by $x\mapsto x\otimes1$ [lem-pur-sheaf-ring-derived-coefficient-adjunction].

For any scheme map $u:V\to W$ between these schemes and any open immersion $j:V\hookrightarrow W$, use the simultaneous system operations $u_C^*,Ru_{*,C},j_{!,C}$ for $C=A,B$ [def-sp-semilinear-constant-ring-operations]. The sectionwise restriction/direct-image identity and its pullback and open-adjunction mates induce natural isomorphisms
$$U_Vu_B^*\cong u_A^*U_W,\qquad U_WRu_{*,B}\cong Ru_{*,A}U_V,\qquad U_Wj_{!,B}\cong j_{!,A}U_V.$$
These specified comparisons preserve the geometric units and counits, the direct-image and open-extension compositors, and the intrinsic proper/open comparisons, including their clopen projectors [def-sf-semilinear-proper-open-comparisons, def-coef-semilinear-proper-open-mate]. For fixed compactifications, write $\mathcal F_{h,C}=Rp_{*,C}j_{!,C}$ for the strict-system compact-support realizations and $\gamma_{g,f,C}$ for the canonical proper/open compactification words formed in these simultaneous system categories [lem-sf-semilinear-proper-open-mate-pasting, thm-sf-comp-composition]. Here the proper/open square $pk=ir$, with top open $k$ and bottom open $i$, uses the well-typed right mate $J_iR_r\to R_pJ_k$ of $P_pJ_i\to J_kP_r$, and its inverse where the compactification word requires it; the scalar comparison does not assert any new invertibility of a proper/open map. Then $U\mathcal F_{h,B}\cong\mathcal F_{h,A}U$, and under these comparisons $U(\gamma_{g,f,B})=\gamma_{g,f,A,U(-)}$ on normalized systems with bounded constructible finite-Tor levels. All compatibilities hold on entire derived systems before evaluation or inverse limit; no uniform bound in $n$ is assumed.

proof.text: Descend the given integral coordinate bijection modulo the principal uniformizer power. For injectivity, lift two tuples; equality of their images says their difference is pi^(n+1) times z. Expand z using the given basis; injectivity of the integral coordinates then says every coordinate difference is divisible by pi^(n+1). For surjectivity lift an upper residue and expand its integral lift. Associated uniformizers have equal principal ideals; taking powers gives ramifiedIdeal. This is the private quotient_basis_bijective proof and the ramifiedIdeal field in Lean.
Apply the normalized scalar specialization to the reduced bases on every scheme, obtaining ScalarAssertions.
Apply the geometric specialization to these scalar assertions, obtaining Geometry with Compatibility for the specified normalized generators.

Expand the compactification comparison and composition word. Paste the gamma square, the open compositor square and the proper compositor square. Naturality moves the scalar comparisons past each factor; functoriality and associativity combine them into the asserted word equation. This calculation holds for every derived-system object, hence for the stated normalized levelwise constructible finite-Tor subclass. Assemble the unchanged Assertions structure.
